notes.title: Nightmare Expansion: New Enemies, New Game Mode, and More!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44279916/9fa4f8f64e9512bd2e3e77061d1e5307858bde68.png[/img]

[h3]Adventurers, after months of work, I am happy to announce the Nightmare Expansion for [i]Claymores of the Lost Kingdom[/i]. Featuring a new game mode, new enemies, events, and more -- this expansion was originally planned to be paid DLC. However, after a hundred hours of testing I realized that it completes the whole experience in such a way that there's no going back. [b]In other words, all of the Nightmare content will be available to everyone for free, today![/b][/h3]

[i]Features:
[list][*]New 'Nightmare' game mode for the bravest and most talented of adventurers ('Legend' achievement required to unlock) with 10 levels of difficulty going from extremely challenging to impossible
[*]More enemies
[*]More events
[*]More status effects
[*]Minor balance changes to the base game mode
[*]Loads of bugs and glitches fixed, and more!
[/list][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44279916/47b0f890093e0064236862cfe338cdcf1732468f.png[/img]

Thank you all for playing and giving the game hundreds of hours, it means a lot!

Kind regards,
the Dev

notes.title: Small Fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed gang panel glitching into a battle.
[*] Fixed local rumors from sometimes giving an "error" message.
[*] Fixed Attunement Stone not working when playing a 0 mana card while at full hand.
[*] Various typos fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Adventure Begins!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44279916/47b0f890093e0064236862cfe338cdcf1732468f.png[/img]

[h2]Adventurers, [i]Claymores of the Lost Kingdom[/i] is now available on Steam for PC![/h2]
Have fun and good luck out there! Ruthia is a dangerous place.
